##### Project general facts

Samana Barari Views by Samana Developers stands as the greenest project in the flagship, aligning perfectly with sustainability and holistic living principles. This architectural marvel emerges amidst tranquil water features and lush greenery, creating a serene oasis where mental and physical rejuvenation take centre stage. Every aspect of this exceptional development has been meticulously crafted to offer residents a lifestyle that transcends the ordinary, making every day a journey to inner peace and every moment a testament to luxurious serenity.

The development sets the standard for world-class amenities, offering residents a life of unparalleled luxury with private pools, lush walking areas, and state-of-the-art fitness facilities. Residents can enjoy relaxing cabana areas and meticulously maintained landscapes that reflect a life of excellence and provide an exceptional living experience. Every amenity has been thoughtfully curated to promote well-being, relaxation, and a deep connection with nature.

Each residence features cutting-edge smart home technology that offers a seamless, connected lifestyle where every aspect of the home is at residents' fingertips. The contemporary design integrates with nature's timeless beauty, featuring a soothing colour palette that sets the tone for solitude and refinement. Units come with built-in kitchen appliances and a smart home system, ensuring effortless living where technology enhances comfort and makes every day an experience in effortless luxury.

##### Location description and benefits

This prestigious residential development is situated in Majan, a substantial district located at the heart of the large Dubailand community. The area offers strategic access to Al Ain, Sharjah, and Abu Dhabi via Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Al Ain Road. The district comprises numerous residential complexes, iconic towers, hotels, and mixed-use units, creating a vibrant and dynamic community.

The location provides proximity to high-ranked schools, business and shopping centers, medical facilities, major amusement parks, and sports facilities, ensuring residents have everything they need within easy reach. The excellent infrastructure and strategic positioning make it an ideal choice for families and professionals seeking convenience and quality of life. The community is particularly attractive for those seeking buy-to-invest properties with promising potential.

The area offers affordable rental rates compared to seashore or central parts of the emirate, attracting both locals and tourists seeking quality accommodation at reasonable prices. The developing community presents excellent opportunities for off-plan housing purchases with attractive discounts. This distinguished location represents the perfect balance of strategic connectivity, developing infrastructure, and investment potential, offering residents an unmatched lifestyle in one of Dubai's most promising communities.
